_comment: Operations the app needs that Galileo core does not register yet. The names are this repository's proposal, not the server's, and exist only so that the mock Master can exercise those screens; a real Master simply lacks them and the screens show that. Empty since core registered device.connect/disconnect, focus.autofocus(+cancel), mount.hold_*, session.skip and flip.defer (CSURF-320..360). Add an entry here when a screen needs something core lacks; remove it when catalogue.json gains the real one.
